system.description:
Effect: Until you use a one-hour or longer recovery, you can easily and effectively swim at a superhuman level. You can swim an immediate distance as your turn and still take another action, swim a short distance as your entire action, or swim a long distance as your entire action if you succeed at a difficulty 4 swimming task (to “run”). Your swimming tasks (such as to avoid a current or whirlpool) are eased by two steps. Your melee attacks while swimming ignore the normal penalties for fighting in water.

Genre Items: potion of swimming (fantasy); drag‑suppressing nanosuit (sci-fi)
